images.title: Adding change or multiplying change?
images.purpose: Shows the sorting move of the practice: an age pair 1 : 5 that grows by adding 3 to each goes into the adding change bin.
images.composition: One card at the top centre and two bins below it, with one arrow from the card into the right bin. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Card: a white rounded rectangle with dark outline colour (#2B2B2B) outline showing '1 : 5' on the left, a small arrow, and '? : ?' on the right, with '+ 3 each' under the arrow. Bottom left bin outlined in green (#009E73) labelled 'multiplying change'; bottom right bin outlined in vermilion (#D55E00) labelled 'adding change'. One reddish purple (#CC79A7) arrow curves from the card into the adding change bin. Exactly 1 card, 2 bins, 1 arrow.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Decide whether a change adds or multiplies before using a proportion.
images.description: Shows the sorting move of the practice: an age pair 1 : 5 that grows by adding 3 to each goes into the adding change bin.
images.context: Harmain 1, brother 5; after 3 years 4 and 8, and 4 : 8 = 1 : 2.

image_decisions.why: Sorting a change before solving is the core skill of this practice, shown with its simplest age example.
